notes: Rack-mounted power distribution unit with Middle Atlantic's non-MOV "Series Protection" surge technology (over-voltage cutoff ≤135VAC, under-voltage cutoff ≥100VAC, auto-restore). 9 total NEMA 5-15R output outlets: 8 mounted on the rear panel, 1 convenience outlet on the front panel — modeled here as two grouped ports (Rear Outlets, Front Outlet) since individual outlets are not separately labeled. Input is a captive 9 ft SignalSAFE cord terminating in a NEMA L5-15P locking plug (distinguishing the -SP Series Protection variant from the base PD-915R, which ships with a standard non-locking NEMA 5-15P plug per manufacturer/retailer documentation) — mapped to the closest available connector id "nema-5-15" since a locking-twist variant is not in the provided enum. No data/signal ports (this is power-only). Specs cross-confirmed across Legrand AV (Middle Atlantic's parent brand) product page, B&H, AVLGEAR, Custom AV Rack, Graybar, and Full Compass listings, which agree on outlet count/layout, 1RU/19"x9.43"x1.735" dimensions, 120VAC/60Hz/15A rating, and 9' cord length. Manufacturer's own PDF datasheet could not be fetched directly (blocked/404), so confidence is medium rather than high.
